g.text: power-of-two padding (impulse phantom, 63 voxels along x)

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: the mirror is edge-exclusive: the padding voxel copies voxel 1 (not voxel 0),

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: so the impulse is duplicated at x = −1, the response peaks at x = 0 and

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: reappears at the far end of the axis, the circular neighbor of the padding

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d
